2026 State of the City

September 10, 2026
Don't miss the Premiere: Thursday, October 8, 2026

Thursday, October 8, 2026 | Historic Civic Center Theater

The City of Corona invites you to the 2026 State of the City, a special evening celebrating where we are today and where we’re headed next. This year’s theme, Grand by Design, highlights Corona’s progress, exciting projects and vision for the future.

🎬 Event Schedule

6:00 PM | Pre-Show Entertainment
6:30 PM | State of the City Address
7:00 PM | Social Reception

📍 Historic Civic Center Theater
815 W. 6th St., Corona, CA 92882

Admission is free, but space is limited! RSVP today to reserve your seat and be part of this special evening.

INVESTIGATION LEADS TO TWO ARRESTS IN SCHOOL THREAT CASE

Corona, CA — On October 6, 2026, the Federal Bureau of Investigation notified the Corona Police Department that they had identified online social media communications regarding a possible school threat to Corona High School. A collaborative investigation led to the immediate arrest of a 15-year-old female Corona High School student.
